title: Heat spreader on a cooled block
pickerTitle: Heat spreader on a cooled block
line: A steady thermal FEA study of a copper spreader on an aluminum block, with a contact conductance at the joint.
description: Steady temperatures through a copper heat spreader (30 x 30 x 3 mm) mounted on an aluminum block of the same footprint, 10 mm thick. A component puts 30 W into the spreader; the block underside is held at 40 C. The joint is written as a contact conductance of 19048 W/m^2/K, a silicone-oil-filled metal contact. The study returns the temperature jump at the joint and the temperatures on each face.
thumbnailAlt: Temperature through a copper spreader and an aluminum block, with a jump at the joint, solved in RunMat
